how_title: 🛠️ Your AI Clone in 3 Easy Steps
how_desc: No technical skills needed. No downloads. Setup takes under 2 minutes.
how_step1_desc: Enter your Gmail address and a Google App Password. This is a special 16-character code from Google — not your real password. You can revoke it anytime from your Google Account.
how_step1_note: Your credentials are encrypted with AES-256 — the same standard used by banks.
how_step2_desc: Paste 3-5 examples of your real email replies. The AI analyzes your writing style — your tone, greeting, sign-off, language preference, and personality — to create a unique Voice Profile.
how_step2_note: The more samples you provide, the more accurate your AI clone becomes.
how_step3_desc: When a new email arrives, your AI clone instantly drafts a reply that sounds exactly like you. Open your dashboard, review the draft, make edits if needed, then approve with one click.
how_step3_note: You stay in full control. Nothing gets sent without your approval.

faq_q3: Can I edit the AI reply?

guide_subtitle: How to retrieve your App Password
guide_gmail_step1: Make sure 2-Step Verification is turned on in your Google settings.
guide_gmail_step3: Type AutoInbox as the app name and click Create.
guide_gmail_step4: Copy the 16-character code and paste it in the connect input without spaces.
guide_yahoo_step2: Scroll down and click Generate app password.
guide_yahoo_step4: Copy the 16-character code and paste it in the connect input without spaces.
trouble_desc: If you encounter "Invalid credentials", make sure your email address is correct and the 16-character code has no spaces. Also ensure you are using a generated App Password and not your personal login password.
